title: Japan Liquidity Enhancement Auction, remaining maturities 5–11 years — the zone the 20-year paper actually clears in, five days before the super-long one
source: EST: mof.go.jp English October 2026 auction calendar (policy/jgbs/auction/calendar/2610e.htm), fetched direct 2026-09-09 (HTTP 200, 24,854 bytes) by the jgb-liquidity-enhancement-11-39y-2026-10-27 initial research, whose table row reads 'Oct. 22, 2026 | Liquidity Enhancement Auction (remaining maturities of 5-11 years)'. No size is carried on the calendar and none is announced — no October row carries an announcement href on 2026-09-09, and MOF's note reads 'Each issue amount will be announced about one week prior to each auction date', putting terms ~2026-10-15. The most recent print in this zone, 2026-08-26 (eresul20260826.htm, HTTP 200, fetched direct 2026-09-09), accepted ¥649.4bn, so this zone runs roughly 2.6x the super-long one. CADENCE IS MONTHLY AND UNBROKEN: MOF's own calendars place a 5-11y (formerly 5-15.5y) Liquidity Enhancement Auction in every single month from 2024-02 through 2026-11 without exception — it is the only one of the three zones that never skips a month, against bi-monthly for the super-long zone and roughly every other month for 1-5y. Filed `estimate` on three counts: no announced size, no reopened-issue list until MOF's own 'Issues Re-opened' page publishes, and market-events-data.ts's confirmed-prefix taxonomy has no slot for a non-US sovereign debt office.
notes: Discovered 2026-09-09 during the jgb-liquidity-enhancement-11-39y-2026-10-27 initial-research adjacency sweep, on MOF's own October calendar. It earns a slot on one specific term, not on calendar completeness: it is the direct falsifier for that ledger's load-bearing finding. All three 11-39y auctions since MOF redefined the zone in April 2026 reopened ZERO 20-year issues despite 20-year issues No.162-196 being explicitly eligible and being 36.3% of the eligible in-band outstanding. The obvious rival explanation is that the paper is simply clearing in the neighbouring zone instead — and the 2026-08-26 5-11y result says exactly that: ¥401.2bn of its ¥649.4bn (61.8%) went to 20-year issues, of which ¥216.1bn sat in the BoJ's 'More than 10 years and up to 25 years' bucket. If the 2026-10-22 print repeats that mix while 10-27 again takes no 20-year paper, the two auctions together show a maturity-segmentation effect rather than a demand failure, and the super-long ledger's leg 3 has to be restated. It also carries the only ¥-flow term the 30-year ledger's absorption arithmetic still leaves open: this zone contributes ~¥216bn/month to the 10-25y bucket, which is what drops the BoJ's measured share of that bucket from ~29% to 20.6%. NO PRICE CHANNEL IS CLAIMED and impact is `low`: no tracked symbol carries yen-rates exposure and no house playbook is rates-keyed. Estimate widens caution only; it licenses no date-keyed action.
